message.content:
**Columbia University**

| Item | Details |
|------|---------|
| **Full name** | Columbia University in the City of New York |
| **Founded** | 1754 (originally King's College) |
| **Location** | Morningside Heights, Manhattan, New York City, NY, USA |
| **Campus size** | ~36 acres (urban campus) |
| **Student population** | ~33,000 total (≈14,000 undergraduates, ≈19,000 graduate & professional students) |
| **Endowment** | ~$12 billion (FY 2023) |
| **Academic structure** | 10 schools & colleges (e.g., Columbia College, Fu Foundation School of Engineering & Applied Science, Mailman School of Public Health, etc.) |
| **Notable alumni** | 5 U.S. Presidents (e.g., Theodore Roosevelt), 2 Nobel laureates (e.g., Paul Krugman), 1 Pulitzer Prize winner (e.g., James Baldwin), 1 Academy Award winner (e.g., Steven Spielberg) |
| **Key research areas** | Biomedical sciences, climate science, artificial intelligence, social sciences, humanities, engineering, journalism (Columbia Journalism School). |
| **Rankings** | QS World University Rankings 2025 – #15 globally; U.S. News & World Report 2025 – #7 among national universities. |
| **Admissions** | Highly selective: acceptance rate ≈ 5–6% (2024‑25 cycle). |
| **Tuition & Fees** | Undergraduate tuition (2025‑26): $68,000; Graduate tuition varies by program. |
| **Athletics** | NCAA Division I (Big East Conference); teams known as the Lions. |

**Quick facts**

* **Motto:** *In lumine Tuo videbimus lumen* (“In Your Light We Shall See the Light”)
* **Mascot:** Lion (named “Lionel” for the football team)
* **Colors:** Columbia blue & white
* **Official website:** https://www.columbia.edu/

If you need more specific details—such as program rankings, faculty achievements, or campus facilities—just let me know!
